name: Database Access
description: Read-only SQL access for SWE via an allowlisted set of connections.

allowlist.label: Connection Allowlist
allowlist.description: Project-keyed map of database connections SWE may target. Each entry pairs a project identifier with a LINQPad-sourced connection name. Numbered clones of a repo (cmms0, cmms1, ...) normalize to one project key by stripping trailing digits, so they share a single entry. Empty map means no DB access. See the table below to manage entries.
